# SoftNest Cleaners

> Upholstery, carpet, area rug, mattress and car interior cleaning company serving Naperville, Aurora, Oswego, Yorkville, Plainfield, Lisle, Wheaton, Downers Grove and nearby western Chicagoland suburbs in Illinois.

SoftNest Cleaners is a family-owned, independent cleaning company (not a franchise). We use hot-water extraction for deep cleaning of upholstery, carpet, area rugs, mattresses and car interiors. All jobs are quoted with clear, upfront pricing based on photos before any work begins. Products used are safe for children and pets.

Contact: (331) 302-2234, softnestcleaners@gmail.com

## Services

- Upholstery cleaning (sofas, sectionals, fabric chairs)
- Carpet cleaning (per room, hallways, staircases)
- Area rug cleaning (wool, synthetic, delicate fibers)
- Mattress cleaning
- Car interior cleaning
- Other/custom fabric cleaning on request

## Service area

Naperville, Aurora, Oswego, Yorkville, Plainfield, Lisle, Wheaton, Downers Grove, IL, and nearby western Chicagoland suburbs.

## Key facts

- Typical visit length: 1-3 hours
- Drying time: 4-8 hours
- Family owned and operated, not a franchise
- Free quotes, pricing shown before work begins
- Kid- and pet-safe cleaning products
